title: Surreal Fruit Fairy Portal
description: A central fairy woman with large golden wings stands in the foreground, her body and dress composed of green grapes, red berries, and flowers. She raises one hand toward a beam of light while surrounded by melting clocks, floating eyeballs, jellyfish, and silver apples. Through a doorway behind her is a realistic domestic scene of a family sitting together in a living room.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a beautiful fairy woman with large translucent golden wings, her body and dress entirely made of green grapes, berries and flowers. She stands in a mystical cosmic environment filled with floating eyeballs, jellyfish, silver apples, and melting clocks draped over stairs. A glowing doorway behind her reveals a normal family sitting in a living room. Dramatic lighting, highly detailed symbolic imagery in the style of Dali and classic fantasy art.
